## 1. Image

Pull, build and push images. Everything else consumes an image reference.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_image` | resource | A Docker image on the provider's daemon. | [reference/docker_image.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_image.md) | [resources/image.md](docs/resources/image.md) |
| `docker_registry_image` | resource | Pushes an image that exists on the provider's daemon (typically a `docker_image`) to its registry, using the provider's `registry_auth` credentials. | [reference/docker_registry_image.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_registry_image.md) | [resources/registry_image.md](docs/resources/registry_image.md) |
| `data.docker_image` | data source | Looks up an image already present on the provider's daemon (no pull). | [reference/data.docker_image.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_image.md) | [data-sources/image.md](docs/data-sources/image.md) |
| `data.docker_registry_image` | data source | Reads the current manifest digest of an image tag from its registry, through the daemon's distribution endpoint (`GET /distribution/<name>/json`) with the provider's `registry_auth`. | [reference/data.docker_registry_image.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_registry_image.md) | [data-sources/registry_image.md](docs/data-sources/registry_image.md) |

| `data.docker_network` | data source | Looks up an existing Docker network (e.g. `bridge`, `host`, or one created outside Terraform) by name or ID. | [reference/data.docker_network.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_network.md) | [data-sources/network.md](docs/data-sources/network.md) |

## 3. Swarm topology

Turn the provider's daemon into a Swarm manager and join further hosts as workers or managers.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_swarm_init` | resource | Initializes a Docker Swarm on the provider's Docker host (`docker swarm init` through the Engine API), making that daemon the first manager. | [reference/docker_swarm_init.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_init.md) | [resources/swarm_init.md](docs/resources/swarm_init.md) |
| `docker_swarm_node` | resource | Joins a Docker host to an existing swarm. | [reference/docker_swarm_node.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_node.md) | [resources/swarm_node.md](docs/resources/swarm_node.md) |
| `data.docker_node` | data source | Looks up one swarm node through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), by `id` (full ID or unique prefix) or `hostname`. | [reference/data.docker_node.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_node.md) | [data-sources/node.md](docs/data-sources/node.md) |
| `data.docker_nodes` | data source | Lists the swarm's nodes through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), sorted by hostname, optionally filtered by `role`. | [reference/data.docker_nodes.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_nodes.md) | [data-sources/nodes.md](docs/data-sources/nodes.md) |
| `data.docker_swarm_tokens` | data source | Reads the join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages (SwarmInspect). | [reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md) | [data-sources/swarm_tokens.md](docs/data-sources/swarm_tokens.md) |

## 4. Swarm workload

Secrets, configs, services and stacks scheduled by the Swarm. Needs layer 3.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_config` | resource | A Swarm config: an immutable, non-secret blob mounted into service tasks as a file. | [reference/docker_config.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_config.md) | [resources/config.md](docs/resources/config.md) |
| `docker_secret` | resource | A Swarm secret: an immutable blob the Swarm managers store encrypted and mount into service tasks under `/run/secrets/<file_name>`. | [reference/docker_secret.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_secret.md) | [resources/secret.md](docs/resources/secret.md) |
| `docker_service` | resource | A Swarm service: a desired number of tasks (containers) of one image scheduled across the Swarm. | [reference/docker_service.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_service.md) | [resources/service.md](docs/resources/service.md) |
| `docker_stack` | resource | A Swarm stack built from API primitives (not a compose file, no CLI): services, overlay networks, secrets and configs, each named `<stack>_<name>` and labelled `com.docker.stack.namespace=<stack>` so `docker stack ls/ps` show them. | [reference/docker_stack.md](skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_stack.md) | [resources/stack.md](docs/resources/stack.md) |
